page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; one column of index entries with page numbers at the right; a catchword "Justinus" at the lower right.
page.notes: Printed page numbers are not visible. The initial letters H and I are large woodcut-style capitals. Underlined and blue-highlighted numbers are marked in the scan but rendered here as plain numbers. Some digits in the page-number column are doubtful, notably "Ioan." style entries and the figures 1, 7 and 9 in several lines. The last line "Justinus" is a catchword and may be a running continuation; it is included in the layout only.
